```lean
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := RCLike.pos_iff_exists_ofReal.mp hαpos
  set c := (((√r)⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by simp [c, Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hr]
  have hcs : starRingEnd 𝕜 c = c := RCLike.conj_ofReal _
  have hcc : c * c * r = 1 := by
    simp only [c, ← RCLike.ofReal_mul, ← mul_inv, Real.mul_self_sqrt hr.le]
    simp [hr.ne']
  let U₀ : V →ₗᵢ[𝕜] W :=
    { (c • (y : V →L[𝕜] W)).toLinearMap with
      norm_map' := (norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self (c • (y : V →L[𝕜] W))).mpr <| by
        simp only [MulActionSemiHomClass.map_smulₛₗ, smul_comp, comp_smulₛₗ, hα, smul_smul,
          hcs, RingHom.id_apply, ← mul_assoc, hcc, one_smul] }
  let U := LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective U₀ fun w ↦ ⟨c⁻¹ • y.symm w, by simp [U₀, smul_smul, hc]⟩
  refine ⟨U, StarAlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun w ↦ ?_⟩
  have hU : U.symm w = c⁻¹ • y.symm w := U.injective <| by simp [U, U₀, smul_smul, hc]
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply, hU]
  simpa [U, U₀, smul_smul, hc] using congr($hy x w)
```

Its RHS `(invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f` is not in simp-normal form. As a result the proof needs three rewrites through `invMonoidHom_comp_invMonoidHom`, and the caller `Subgroup.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf` needs the auxiliary `f'`, `h₁` and `h₂`.
requested_change:
Restate it with pointwise inversion:
```lean
open scoped Pointwise in
@[to_additive]
lemma IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv [InvolutiveInv ι]
    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹) (f : G →* S) :
    v '' baseOf v f⁻¹ = (v '' baseOf v f)⁻¹ := by
  suffices ∀ (f : G →* S), v '' baseOf v f⁻¹ ⊆ (v '' baseOf v f)⁻¹ by
    refine (this f).antisymm ?_
    simpa [Set.inv_subset] using this f⁻¹
  clear f
  rintro f - ⟨i, ⟨hi, hi'⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i⁻¹, ⟨by simpa [hv_inv] using hi, fun j hj k hk hi ↦ ?_⟩, by simp [hv_inv]⟩
  replace hi : v i = v j⁻¹ * v k⁻¹ := by
    rwa [hv_inv, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, mul_inv, ← hv_inv, ← hv_inv] at hi
  specialize hi' j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) hi
  aesop
```
The second bullet of the Subgroup lemma then shrinks to
```lean
  have : univ = {i | 1 < f (v i)} ∪ {i | 1 < f⁻¹ (v i)} := by ext i; simp [(hf i).symm]
  ...
  · rw [← closure_inv (v '' _), ← IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv v hv_inv]
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_closure_toSubmonoid _)
    simp [Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf]
```
After this, `invMonoidHom_comp_invMonoidHom` is no longer needed by the PR.
